title: 第一卷 第30章 给她药，她就吃
content_zh:
霍放的腰间紧缩。

    他的喉咙里发出一声舒适的喘息。

    霍放从来不知道自己对这件事食髓知味，一见到她就上头。

    他把脸再一次埋在她的肩膀处，粗重的气息湿热着她的肌肤，撩拨着她的神经线。

    童喻原本是有些心猿意马，这会儿脑子里却想着方印说的事。

    这是她这半年来，收到的为数不多的好消息。

    一直都知道步入社会，很多事情都是需要靠关系来维持和推进，只是不曾想，她从学校里出来的第一分工作，也是靠着借用霍放名字才有的。

    现在，连最难等到的肾源，她也找了关系才有了希望。

    童喻动情，手上不由得用力，双臂交缠在霍放的背后，身体也不由得向上绷紧。

    “在回味？”霍放感觉到她身体释放的力量。

    童喻没有。

    她只是一股情绪释放出来，控制不了的小动作。

    见她不说话，霍放撑起上半身，垂眸看她，“休息好了？”

    童喻眸子里的春色已经散尽，她这会儿不想再沉迷于男色了。

    晚上，还要上班呢。

    “我想休息。”她的手轻轻地推着他的腰。

    霍放眯眸，显然还意犹未尽。

    他以为，她还想要。

    童喻眼里带着一丝祈求，“一会儿，还要去上班。”

    她不能把体力全都使在他这里了。

    体力透支，有点困。

    霍放也尊重她。

    起身。

    他看了眼她家的洗手间，就有些不情愿。

    最后，还是赤着脚走进去了。

    进去之前，他捡起他的衣服，盖在童喻的身上。

    这个举动让童喻的眼眸动了动。

    霍放这一次在洗手间里没有再吐槽了。

    有些事情，只要经历过一次，就没有那么难接受了。

    等他出来，童喻身上裹着浴巾，把他上次留在家里的衣服拿给他。

    霍放都忘记了。

    接过衣服，勾唇，“倒是不用让秦柯送了。”

    童喻可不想再让秦柯来。

    这种事情，自己不觉得有什么，外人知道了还是挺尬尴的。
content_en:
Huo Fang's waist tightened.

    A comforting gasp escaped his throat.

    Huo Fang never knew that he knew anything about this matter, and he fell in love with her as soon as he saw her.

    He buried his face in her shoulder again, his heavy breath moistening her skin and teasing her nerves.

    Tong Yu was originally a little distracted, but now he was thinking about what Fang Yin said.

    This is one of the few pieces of good news she has received in the past six months.

    She has always known that when entering society, many things need to be maintained and promoted by relationships, but she never thought that her first job after school was obtained by borrowing Huo Fang's name.

    Now, even for the most difficult-to-find kidney source, she had to find connections to have hope.

    Tong Yu was so emotional that she couldn't help but exert force on her hands, her arms were intertwined behind Huo Fang's back, and her body couldn't help but tighten up.

    "Reminiscing?" Huo Fang felt the power released from her body.

    Tong Yu didn’t.

    She just released a small movement of emotions that she couldn't control.

    Seeing that she didn't speak, Huo Fang propped up his upper body and looked down at her, "Have you rested yet?"

    The spring color in Tong Yu's eyes has disappeared, and she no longer wants to indulge in male lust.

    In the evening, I have to go to work.

    "I want to rest." Her hands gently pushed his waist.

    Huo Fang narrowed his eyes, obviously still unfinished.

    He thought she still wanted it.

    There was a trace of prayer in Tong Yu's eyes, "I have to go to work in a while."

    She couldn't use all her strength on him.

    I'm exhausted and a little sleepy.

    Huo Fang also respects her.

    Get up.

    He glanced at her bathroom and felt a little reluctant.

    Finally, I walked in barefoot.

    Before going in, he picked up his clothes and covered Tong Yu's body.

    This move made Tong Yu's eyes move.

    Huo Fang didn't complain in the bathroom this time.

    Some things are not so difficult to accept once you have experienced them once.

    When he came out, Tong Yu was wrapped in a bath towel and gave him the clothes he left at home last time.

    Huo Fang had forgotten it.

    He took the clothes and curled his lips, "There's no need for Qin Ke to give it away."

    Tong Yu didn't want Qin Ke to come again.

    I don't think anything of this kind of thing, but it's quite embarrassing for outsiders to find out.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 30 Give her medicine and she will take it
